confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July is peak season in Hokkaido and rates vary widely by property and date. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship and general knowledge of Japanese bar and restaurant pricing, not from direct price checks. FX NOT VERIFIED: no official rba.gov.au USD/AUD observation could be retrieved in this session, so all fx fields are null and the fx value must not be used until a verified RBA observation is supplied. Unofficial third-party sites reported roughly 0.69 to 0.70 USD per AUD around 16 October 2026, but these are not RBA data and were not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other mid-sized Japanese regional cities such as Sendai and Fukuoka, adjusted for Sapporo's higher summer accommodation demand in July.
